paraphrase: Whatever operates from itself and is moved in no respect lives at some time of the duration frame. Encodes ST I q.18 a.3 co. ('vivere dicuntur aliqua secundum quod operantur ex seipsis, et non quasi ab aliis mota'); 'not as moved by others' is strengthened in the antecedent to 'moved in no respect', which makes the statement weaker than the source sentence.
